verdict.rationale: Jeeves ships several fixed, finance-specific automations: automatic emails to employees when receipts or memos are missing, automated invoice payment and approval flows, and scheduled future-dated payments. It also offers real-time webhooks and an MCP server that lets autonomous agents act on company finances. However, there is no evidence of a user-configurable automation builder or of rules and agents that run on their own in the background; background autonomy depends on the user building integrations through the API, webhooks or MCP. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules or workflow builder, native scheduled or recurring agent tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
